task_title: Shipped GET /metrics/prom absent from the authoritative OpenAPI surface
task_criteria: Add GET /metrics/prom to pkg/api/openapi.yaml and the served OpenAPI response schema with its text exposition content type (text/plain; version=0.0.4); add a regression parity test; on a fresh build prove /metrics/prom is present in /openapi.json and still returns HTTP 200 with that content type. REJECTS: editing README.md or docs/observability-spec.md.

items.criterion: Add GET /metrics/prom to pkg/api/openapi.yaml and the served OpenAPI response schema with its text exposition content type (text/plain; version=0.0.4); add a regression parity test; on a fresh build prove /metrics/prom is present in /openapi.json and still returns HTTP 200 with that content type. REJECTS: editing README.md or docs/observability-spec.md.
items.detail: Spec: pkg/api/openapi.yaml:493-515 adds `/metrics/prom: get:` with operationId getMetricsProm, tags [stats], a 200-only response and content key `'text/plain; version=0.0.4'` with `schema: type: string`. Served path: pkg/api/spec.go JSONBytes() -> cmd/off-by-one/main.go:99 -> main.go:229-230 apihttp.New(store, queue, specBytes) -> internal/api/server.go:98 OpenAPISpec -> server.go:182 `mux.HandleFunc("GET /openapi.json", s.handleOpenAPI)` -> server.go:355-364 writes the bytes. Regression parity tests: pkg/api/metrics_prom_parity_test.go (TestOpenAPISpec_MetricsPromDocumented, TestOpenAPISpec_MetricsPromMediaTypeMatchesHandler), internal/api/openapi_metrics_prom_test.go (TestServedOpenAPISpec_DocumentsMetricsProm), plus /metrics/prom added to the required list in pkg/api/handlers_test.go:45. Fresh-build proof: `go build -o /tmp/ob1 ./cmd/off-by-one` then `curl http://127.0.0.1:18772/openapi.json` => `openapi_status=200`, `path_present= True`, content block `{"text/plain; version=0.0.4": {"schema": {"type": "string"}}}`; `curl http://127.0.0.1:18772/metrics/prom` => `prom_status=200`, `Content-Type: text/plain; version=0.0.4; charset=utf-8; escaping=underscores`, body begins `# HELP obo_catalog_hit_rate ...`. Tests: `go test ./pkg/api/... -run MetricsProm -count=1 -v` => `--- PASS: TestOpenAPISpec_MetricsPromDocumented`, `--- PASS: TestOpenAPISpec_MetricsPromMediaTypeMatchesHandler`, `ok .../pkg/api 0.010s`; `go test ./internal/api/... -run 'MetricsProm|OpenAPISpec' -count=1 -v` => `--- PASS: TestServedOpenAPISpec_DocumentsMetricsProm`, `ok .../internal/api 0.026s`; full `go test ./... -short -p 1 -count=1 -timeout 180s` => all packages `ok`. REJECTS honored: `git diff --name-only a60a91dd ab6613b6` lists only go.mod, go.sum, internal/api/openapi_metrics_prom_test.go, pkg/api/handlers_test.go, pkg/api/metrics_prom_parity_test.go, pkg/api/openapi.yaml — grep for README.md|docs/observability-spec.md returned NONE. [resolution 0.64; pkg/api/openapi.yaml, /openapi.json, README.md]

items.criterion: The new parity test actually fails when the /metrics/prom spec entry is removed (it is a real regression guard, not a tautology).
items.detail: Red-proof executed: after deleting the `/metrics/prom:` block from pkg/api/openapi.yaml, `go test ./pkg/api/... -run MetricsProm -count=1` => `--- FAIL: TestOpenAPISpec_MetricsPromDocumented  metrics_prom_parity_test.go:29: served spec has no /metrics/prom path (16 paths documented)` and `--- FAIL: TestOpenAPISpec_MetricsPromMediaTypeMatchesHandler  metrics_prom_parity_test.go:65: key "/metrics/prom" = <nil> (<nil>), want a mapping`. File restored (`git diff --stat -- pkg/api/openapi.yaml` empty) and `go test ./pkg/api/... -count=1` => `ok ... 0.212s`.

items.criterion: The media type the spec documents is the media type the handler actually writes (no documented lie).
items.detail: Spec documents `text/plain; version=0.0.4` (pkg/api/openapi.yaml:512); handler internal/api/server.go:397 `s.Prom.Handler().ServeHTTP(w, r)` (promhttp). Live fresh-build curl returned `Content-Type: text/plain; version=0.0.4; charset=utf-8; escaping=underscores`, which matches the documented media type as a prefix. pkg/api/metrics_prom_parity_test.go:69-73 additionally asserts `application/json` is NOT documented for the path, and internal/api/openapi_metrics_prom_test.go:50-53 asserts the live route's Content-Type has that prefix.

items.criterion: The documented path is reachable from the real server entrypoint (main.go -> /openapi.json), not only from a test fixture.
items.detail: cmd/off-by-one/main.go:99 `openapiBytes, err := api.JSONBytes()`; main.go:229-230 `specBytes := openapiBytes; apiServer := apihttp.New(store, queue, specBytes)`; internal/api/server.go:98 `OpenAPISpec: spec`; server.go:182 registers `GET /openapi.json`; server.go:355-364 writes those bytes. Confirmed end-to-end on a freshly built binary: `curl /openapi.json` returned `path_present= True` with the exposition content block.

items.criterion: The change does not edit README.md or docs/observability-spec.md (the task's explicit REJECTS).
items.detail: `git diff --name-only a60a91dd ab6613b6 | grep -E "README.md|docs/observability-spec.md"` => `NONE (good)`. The merge commit fecbac11 touches only internal/api/openapi_metrics_prom_test.go, pkg/api/handlers_test.go, pkg/api/metrics_prom_parity_test.go, pkg/api/openapi.yaml. The go.mod/go.sum churn visible in the branch diff is a stale-branch artifact not carried into the merge: HEAD go.mod equals a60a91dd's go.mod and `git diff --stat -- go.mod go.sum` is empty.

items.criterion: The change introduces no build/vet/format/test regressions across the repository.
items.detail: `go build ./...` exit 0; `go vet ./...` exit 0; `gofmt -l cmd/ internal/ pkg/ sql/` produced no output; `go test ./... -short -p 1 -count=1 -timeout 180s` => every package `ok` (cmd/off-by-one, internal/api, internal/cron, internal/export, internal/graph, internal/import, internal/ingest, internal/metrics, internal/muster, internal/sandbox, internal/seed, internal/solver, internal/tools, internal/web, pkg/api). `go test ./pkg/api/... -run TestOpenAPISpec_AllEndpointsDocumented -count=1 -v` => `--- PASS` with /metrics/prom now in the required list (pkg/api/handlers_test.go:45).
